# Kitora

> A React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 design kit for complex apps, as 36 @kitora packages. Every fact below is generated from the source; each package's full API (exports, props with types and defaults, parts) is a JSON file under /api/.

## Packages

- [@kitora/ai-chat](/docs/packages/ai-chat): Kitora's AI chat UI: a framework-free chat core (message tree with branches, stream folding, streaming-safe markdown, a pluggable adapter seam with a scripted fake) with React bindings and styled parts: transcript, composer with attachments and slash commands, tool-call cards, agent step traces, a context-usage meter, a model selector, citations, reasoning, artifacts panel, conversation list. API: [/api/ai-chat.json](/api/ai-chat.json)
- [@kitora/auth](/docs/packages/auth): Kitora's auth and account UI: a framework-free core (adapter contract with a fake, password strength and policy, OTP model, backup codes, TOTP URIs, a QR encoder, sessions, roles and permissions, invites), a browser-behaviour layer (clipboard and file-save adapters), headless React hooks, and styled presets for sign in, sign up, password reset, two-step verification, email verification, account and security settings, and roles and members. API: [/api/auth.json](/api/auth.json)
- [@kitora/charts](/docs/packages/charts): Kitora's charts on plain SVG: line, area, bar (grouped, stacked, horizontal), combined, pie and donut, radar, radial bar, gauge, funnel, scatter, sparkline and heatmap, plus a ranked bars list in HTML, with axes, legends, crosshair tooltips, a table fallback, keyboard reading, SVG and PNG export and light and dark palettes. Scale and shape maths live in the kit; no chart library. API: [/api/charts.json](/api/charts.json)
- [@kitora/chat](/docs/packages/chat): Kitora's messaging and collaboration kit: a framework-free chat core (timeline grouping, reactions, mentions, receipts, a pluggable realtime adapter with a fake one for demos), anchored comment threads, an activity feed and an audit log with diffs, plus compact styled React parts. API: [/api/chat.json](/api/chat.json)
- [@kitora/collab](/docs/packages/collab): Kitora's real-time collaboration primitives: presence with idle and away, live cursors, shared selection highlights, follow mode and an undo/redo history with time travel, over a transport-agnostic adapter (BroadcastChannel, in-memory, Yjs awareness). API: [/api/collab.json](/api/collab.json)
- [@kitora/collections](/docs/packages/collections): Kitora's collection components: one headless collection model (items, sections, selection, disabled, typeahead, virtual window, async loading, trees) with APG-correct Listbox, Select, Combobox, MultiSelect, TagsInput, Menu, Menubar, ContextMenu, Toolbar, TreeView (drag to reorder, inline rename, and a FileTree preset of folders and files), TreeSelect and Cascader on it. API: [/api/collections.json](/api/collections.json)
- [@kitora/commerce](/docs/packages/commerce): Kitora's commerce kit: pricing tables with a billing toggle and comparison matrix, a cart with coupons and tax, a checkout flow with a card field that never stores data, order summaries and invoices, and a Calendly-style booking widget across time zones, on a framework-free core with pluggable adapters. API: [/api/commerce.json](/api/commerce.json)
- [@kitora/datagrid](/docs/packages/datagrid): Kitora's headless, adapter-driven datagrid: providers, filters, sort, pagination, infinite scroll, layouts (table, cards, kanban, media grid), saved views, row reorder and the styled parts. API: [/api/datagrid.json](/api/datagrid.json)
- [@kitora/display](/docs/packages/display): Kitora's data display components: code blocks with a built-in highlighter, description lists, a JSON viewer, timelines, stat cards with sparklines, avatars with presence, person cards, badges, count badges and tags, a copy button, a carousel, a masonry layout that keeps reading order, accordion and tab variants, hints, hover cards and an image gallery on the overlay kit's Lightbox. API: [/api/display.json](/api/display.json)
- [@kitora/dnd](/docs/packages/dnd): Kitora's drag-and-drop kit: a framework-free engine, DOM sensors and presentation, trees, React bindings, styled presets, an HTML5 bridge and devtools. API: [/api/dnd.json](/api/dnd.json)
- [@kitora/dock](/docs/packages/dock): Kitora's docking engine: an n-ary layout model with a pure reducer and size solver, the one SplitView splitter, tab groups, floating windows and popouts, and React bindings with styled parts. API: [/api/dock.json](/api/dock.json)
- [@kitora/editors](/docs/packages/editors): Kitora's editors: a Tiptap rich-text editor (compact toolbar, bubble menu, slash commands, mentions, links, tables, code blocks, images, markdown import and export), a markdown editor with live preview, and a CodeMirror 6 code editor, with shortcuts on the keyboard kit. API: [/api/editors.json](/api/editors.json)
- [@kitora/feedback](/docs/packages/feedback): Kitora's feedback kit: toasts (queue, stacking, swipe, pause, undo, promise, dedupe, positions) with an imperative API and a provider, a notification inbox with a bell, banners and inline alerts (on the ui Alert primitive), progress, the stepper (Stepper parts, Steps and StepProgress), spinners, skeletons, empty states and result pages, on a framework-free core. API: [/api/feedback.json](/api/feedback.json)
- [@kitora/flow](/docs/packages/flow): Kitora's node and flow editor: a framework-free graph core (ports, edges, viewport, layered auto-layout, connection rules, undo history, clipboard, JSON) with a React canvas on the dnd kit's activation and interactive-press rules and the keyboard kit's keymap (pan, zoom, pinch, drag, marquee, connect, snap and guides, keyboard) and styled minimap, controls and node cards. API: [/api/flow.json](/api/flow.json)
- [@kitora/form](/docs/packages/form): Kitora's form engine: a framework-free core, React bindings, the field catalog, auto forms, data sources, server validation, Yjs collaboration and devtools. API: [/api/form.json](/api/form.json)
- [@kitora/form-builder](/docs/packages/form-builder): Kitora's visual form builder: a field palette, a drag-to-reorder canvas of live widgets, a properties panel (label, name, required, rules, options, conditions, default), sections and wizard steps, preview, undo and redo, and export / import as the form engine's JSON definition rendered by AutoForm. API: [/api/form-builder.json](/api/form-builder.json)
- [@kitora/i18n](/docs/packages/i18n): Kitora's shared message catalog: typed per-kit namespaces with English defaults, locale bundles with fallback (de-AT → de → en), single-key overrides, {name} interpolation and Intl.PluralRules plurals, a nesting I18nProvider with no global state, and a locale-to-direction bridge to the theme kit. API: [/api/i18n.json](/api/i18n.json)
- [@kitora/keyboard](/docs/packages/keyboard): Kitora's keyboard kit: a framework-free command registry, keybinding layers with user overrides, when-clauses, chords and sequences, conflict analysis, DOM dispatch, roving focus, React bindings, a VS Code-style shortcuts editor, a cheatsheet, palette rows and key hints. API: [/api/keyboard.json](/api/keyboard.json)
- [@kitora/maps](/docs/packages/maps): Kitora's maps and location kit: a framework-free geo core (bounds, distance, clustering, routes, a geocoder adapter, an autocomplete state machine), a MapLibre engine seam, React parts (map, markers, popups, clusters, routes) and styled presets (location picker, address autocomplete). Each layer is its own entry (`/core`, `/dom`, `/react`, `/ui`), plus opt-in `/samples` data. No API keys. API: [/api/maps.json](/api/maps.json)
- [@kitora/overlay](/docs/packages/overlay): Kitora's overlay stack: a headless core, React bindings, styled presets, a router adapter and an imperative API. API: [/api/overlay.json](/api/overlay.json)
- [@kitora/pickers](/docs/packages/pickers): Kitora's date, time and colour pickers: typed-segment date and time fields, calendars (single, multiple, range), range presets, month, year, week and quarter pickers, datetime, a time-zone picker, an RRULE recurrence editor, a colour picker and an emoji picker, on a framework-free core with Intl locales and RTL. API: [/api/pickers.json](/api/pickers.json)
- [@kitora/primitives](/docs/packages/primitives): Kitora's own headless primitives: renderer-neutral state and maths (core), DOM behaviour (dom) and unstyled React parts (react), plus the behaviour stylesheet (state-attribute variants, enter and exit animations) the styled packages rely on. Nothing third-party but React. API: [/api/primitives.json](/api/primitives.json)
- [@kitora/scheduling](/docs/packages/scheduling): Kitora's scheduling kit: an event calendar (month, week, day, agenda, resource timeline) with drag to move, resize and create, all-day lanes, overlap layout, time zones and RRULE expansion, plus a Gantt chart with dependencies, drag bars, zoom levels and a today line, on a framework-free core. API: [/api/scheduling.json](/api/scheduling.json)
- [@kitora/search](/docs/packages/search): Kitora's search and data tools: a framework-free search core (ranking, grouping, facets, highlight, recents), a visual query builder model (AND/OR groups, typed operators, JSON, evaluation), a CSV import pipeline (parse, map, validate), and styled React parts for each. API: [/api/search.json](/api/search.json)
- [@kitora/shell](/docs/packages/shell): Kitora's application shell: a thin composition of @kitora/sidebar with a header (breadcrumbs, search, notifications, user menu), page header with tabs, a resizable inspector on the dock's SplitView, a status bar, a mobile drawer, and layout presets (sidebar, double sidebar, top nav, settings). API: [/api/shell.json](/api/shell.json)
- [@kitora/sidebar](/docs/packages/sidebar): Kitora's application sidebar: a framework-free nav model (tree, sections, badges, active matching, moves, persisted state) with React bindings, resize on the dock's SplitView, drag reorder on the dnd kit, and styled ClickUp / Slack / Linear / VS Code / Notion-grade presets. API: [/api/sidebar.json](/api/sidebar.json)
- [@kitora/spreadsheet](/docs/packages/spreadsheet): Kitora's spreadsheet grid in layers: a framework-free sheet model (addresses, a pluggable formula engine with dependency-ordered recalculation, selection, clipboard codecs, fill series, sort, undo), headless grid behaviour, unstyled React hooks, and styled compound parts (toolbar, formula bar, virtualised grid, status bar) with a preset built from them. API: [/api/spreadsheet.json](/api/spreadsheet.json)
- [@kitora/tabster](/docs/packages/tabster): Kitora's tabbed dock, a preset on @kitora/dock: panels, persistence adapters, group names, outliner, arrange overlay and keyboard handling. API: [/api/tabster.json](/api/tabster.json)
- [@kitora/task-list](/docs/packages/task-list): Kitora's headless, adapter-driven task lists: provider, list and kanban boards with drag, filters, saved views, bulk actions and the styled parts. API: [/api/task-list.json](/api/task-list.json)
- [@kitora/terminal](/docs/packages/terminal): Kitora's developer views: a terminal emulator view (ANSI colours, cursor, scrollback, input with history, pluggable session adapter), a virtualised log viewer (levels, filter, search, follow tail, JSON expansion), a split and unified diff viewer with word-level highlighting, and a JSON / YAML tree diff, on a framework-free core that stays fast at 100k lines. API: [/api/terminal.json](/api/terminal.json)
- [@kitora/theme](/docs/packages/theme): Kitora's foundations and theming: OKLCH colour scales from one brand colour with contrast-checked foreground pairs, radius / spacing / type / density scales, a ThemeProvider (light, dark, system, per-subtree themes, density), CSS-variable and Tailwind exporters, a live theme designer and a WCAG contrast checker. API: [/api/theme.json](/api/theme.json)
- [@kitora/tour](/docs/packages/tour): Kitora's onboarding kit: a framework-free tour machine (steps, progress, resume, route-aware), spotlight maths, checklist and announcement models, with headless React hooks and styled presets (tour popover on the overlay kit, beacons, coach marks, onboarding checklist, what's new); the stepper is re-exported from the feedback kit. API: [/api/tour.json](/api/tour.json)
- [@kitora/ui](/docs/packages/ui): Kitora's styled components in the shadcn style, on @kitora/primitives and Tailwind v4, one entry per component, and the cn helper. API: [/api/ui.json](/api/ui.json)
- [@kitora/upload](/docs/packages/upload): Kitora's files and media kit: a dropzone with validation, an upload queue on a pluggable (and chunked, resumable) adapter, an image cropper, avatar upload, a media library, and image, PDF, video and audio viewers. API: [/api/upload.json](/api/upload.json)
- [@kitora/whiteboard](/docs/packages/whiteboard): Kitora's whiteboard: an SVG infinite canvas (shapes, freehand, select / move / resize / rotate, groups, z-order, undo, SVG / PNG / JSON) on a framework-free pointer engine, plus a mind map and an org chart on the same camera and tree layout. API: [/api/whiteboard.json](/api/whiteboard.json)
- [@kitora/windows](/docs/packages/windows): Kitora's floating window manager: a framework-free core (states, snapping, z-order, persistence) with DOM gestures, React bindings and macOS / Windows / neutral chrome presets. API: [/api/windows.json](/api/windows.json)

## Components

- [Button](/components/button): Eight intents, five sizes, icon-only variants. Compact-first — 32px default. Slot-based via asChild. `import { Button } from "@kitora/ui/button"`
- [IconButton](/components/icon-button): Icon-only button with a required label, a pressed state for toggles and a native or styled tooltip. The one every kit toolbar uses. `import { IconButton } from "@kitora/ui/icon-button"`
- [CloseButton](/components/close-button): The one × for every dismissable surface: an IconButton preset named "Close" by default, 24px minimum pointer target, drawn as a primitive Close part through `render`. `import { CloseButton } from "@kitora/ui/close-button"`
- [ButtonGroup](/components/button-group): Joined buttons. Shares borders, rounds only outer corners. Plus SegmentedGroup for toolbars. `import { ButtonGroup } from "@kitora/ui/button-group"`
- [SplitButton](/components/split-button): Main action + dropdown chevron in one joined unit. Deploy ▼ / Save ▼ patterns. `import { SplitButton } from "@kitora/ui/split-button"`
- [Toggle](/components/toggle): Two-state pressable button — bold/italic/underline-style controls. `import { Toggle } from "@kitora/ui/toggle"`
- [ToggleGroup](/components/toggle-group): Single or multi-select group of toggle buttons. Type, alignment, view-style toolbars. `import { ToggleGroup } from "@kitora/ui/toggle-group"`
- [SegmentedControl](/components/segmented-control): One value of a few as segments in a track, never empty. Toggle or radio semantics, three sizes, an optional sliding indicator. `import { SegmentedControl } from "@kitora/ui/segmented-control"`
- [FloatButton](/components/float-button): A floating action button pinned to a logical viewport corner above the safe area: an Affix holding a Button, in three sizes, round or square, extended with text, as a link, with a count or dot badge and a tooltip. BackToTop is its preset. `import { FloatButton } from "@kitora/ui/float-button"`
- [Toolbar](/components/toolbar): A row of buttons, toggles, links, inputs and menu triggers with one tab stop and arrow-key movement. `import { Toolbar } from "@kitora/ui/toolbar"`
- [CopyButton](/components/copy-button): Icon button that copies a value, swaps to a check and announces the result politely. The display kit's CopyButton. `import { CopyButton } from "@kitora/display"`
- [Input](/components/input): Single-line text. Includes invalid state via aria-invalid. `import { Input } from "@kitora/ui/input"`
- [Textarea](/components/textarea): Multi-line text. Auto-resizes when configured by host. `import { Textarea } from "@kitora/ui/textarea"`
- [Label](/components/label): Accessible form label. Pairs with every input. `import { Label } from "@kitora/ui/label"`
- [Field](/components/field): A label, a control, a description and an error wired together, with the field state (valid, invalid, dirty, touched, filled, focused) and validation on submit, blur or change. Works with Input, Checkbox, Switch, RadioGroup and Slider. `import { Field } from "@kitora/ui/field"`
- [Fieldset](/components/fieldset): A native fieldset named by its legend. A disabled fieldset disables the fields inside it. `import { Fieldset } from "@kitora/ui/fieldset"`
- [Form](/components/form): A native form over Field: blocks a submit while a field is invalid, focuses the first one, hands the values to onFormSubmit and shows server errors under their fields. `import { Form } from "@kitora/ui/form"`
- [Select](/components/select): Kitora's select: a button that opens a list of options, laid over the trigger with the chosen item on its value. Single or multiple, groups, scroll arrows, typeahead, a search box (`searchable`), Field and Form. The kits use it, and the collections kit's Select (items as data) is an adapter over it. Use NativeSelect instead where the platform's own control is wanted: a form that must work without JavaScript, or the native picker on a phone. `import { Select } from "@kitora/ui/select"`
- [Slider](/components/slider): Range / value picker. Single or multi-thumb. `import { Slider } from "@kitora/ui/slider"`
- [Calendar](/components/calendar): Month grid with single, multiple and range modes, whole weeks, and month, quarter and year grids; Intl names and month/year drill-up. The pickers kit's Calendar. `import { Calendar } from "@kitora/pickers"`
- [DatePicker](/components/date-picker): One date picker for every mode: a day, several days, a range, or one or a range of weeks, months, quarters or years, as ISO strings; with a time granularity a date-time or a date-time range (floating, a UTC instant or RFC 9557 zoned, in a display zone with a zone switch, a second-zone hint and fixed offsets), and time and time-range modes. Presets in every mode (rolling presets that stay relative to today), compare periods (previous period or year), nights or days, open-ended ranges, one field or two, ranges across disabled days, and range ends dragged by pointer or moved with Shift+arrows. Rules as data with reasons (weekdays, holidays, ranges, past or future only) shown on the day and announced, and async day data such as prices under the days. Typed segments or free text with natural language, calendar popover with a time list or columns, min / max bounds, clear, Apply / Cancel in every mode. Beside it the SlotPicker: free time slots from an availability adapter on the same calendar and zone parts, in a month or week layout. The pickers kit's DatePicker. `import { DatePicker } from "@kitora/pickers/ui"`
- [TagsInput](/components/tag-input): Type a tag, hit Enter and a chip appears; Backspace removes. The collections kit's TagsInput. `import { TagsInput } from "@kitora/collections/ui"`
- [MaskInput](/components/mask-input): Text that formats as you type (phone, card, IBAN, codes): the caret stays where you type, Backspace skips the literals, a paste fills in order, and the raw value posts with the form. `import { MaskInput } from "@kitora/ui/mask-input"`
- [SearchInput](/components/search-input): Search field with icon + ⌘K hint chip + optional clear button. `import { SearchInput } from "@kitora/ui/search-input"`
- [Combobox](/components/combobox): An input you search a list with: type to filter, arrows to highlight (focus stays in the input), Enter to choose. Single or multiple with chips, groups, async lists, a search box inside the popup, Field and Form. The collections kit's Combobox (items as data, free text, async loading built in) builds on the same core. `import { Combobox } from "@kitora/ui/combobox"`
- [Autocomplete](/components/autocomplete): An input whose text is the value, with suggestions under it. Filter as you type, complete inline as you arrow, or both; groups, async suggestions, a search box that submits its form. `import { Autocomplete } from "@kitora/ui/autocomplete"`
- [PasswordInput](/components/password-input): Password with reveal toggle + optional strength meter. `import { PasswordInput } from "@kitora/ui/password-input"`
- [NumberField](/components/number-field): Locale-aware number input with steppers: Intl formatting, min / max / step (Shift and Alt for large and small), the arrow keys, press and hold, the wheel, a scrub area to drag a value, and a Field-aware label, description and error. The `NumberFieldControl` preset (commit on blur or Enter, steppers on or off, `name` posting the raw number) over the styled Base UI NumberField parts; the pickers kit's `NumberInput` renders them. `import { NumberField } from "@kitora/ui/number-field"`
- [OTPField](/components/otp-field): One box per character of a one-time code: typing moves on, a paste or an autofill spreads the code, Backspace steps back, digits, letters or your own rule, a mask, completion and auto-submit. The `OTPField` preset (groups, sm / md / lg boxes from the `otp` slot, `name` posting the code) over the styled Base UI OTPFieldPreview parts; the pickers and auth kits' `OtpField` render them. `import { OTPField } from "@kitora/ui/otp-field"`
- [Dropzone](/components/file-upload): Drag-drop or click to pick files, with accept and size limits, rejection reasons and a file list. The upload kit's Dropzone. `import { Dropzone } from "@kitora/upload/ui"`
- [FileTrigger](/components/file-trigger): A "Choose file" button with no drop area: any button opens the file dialog, every pick is split by the upload rules, folders and the phone camera are one prop away, and with a name a plain form posts the files. The upload kit's FileTrigger. `import { FileTrigger } from "@kitora/upload/ui"`
- [InputGroup](/components/input-group): Input or textarea with inline addons — icons, text, buttons — sharing one border and focus ring. `import { InputGroup } from "@kitora/ui/input-group"`
- [NativeSelect](/components/native-select): The platform's own select, styled, at h-7. For a form that must work without JavaScript, or where the native picker on a phone is wanted; everywhere else use Select. `import { NativeSelect } from "@kitora/ui/native-select"`
- [InlineEdit](/components/inline-edit): Text that turns into a field in place: Enter saves, Escape restores, with validation, async saves and optional Save / Cancel buttons. The pickers kit's InlineEdit. `import { InlineEdit } from "@kitora/pickers/ui"`
- [ColorPicker](/components/color-picker): Colour panel with area, hue and alpha sliders, typed values and presets, inline or in a popover, plus ColorSwatches on its own. The pickers kit's ColorPicker. `import { ColorPicker } from "@kitora/pickers/ui"`
- [EmojiPicker](/components/emoji-picker): Pick an emoji from a popover or an inline panel: names for screen readers, search, categories, recently used, skin tones, and a value mode that posts with a form. The pickers kit's EmojiPicker. `import { EmojiPicker } from "@kitora/pickers/ui"`
- [Cascader](/components/cascader): Pick a path through nested options, one column per level, leaf-only or any level, with lazy children. The collections kit's Cascader. `import { Cascader } from "@kitora/collections/ui"`
- [TreeSelect](/components/tree-select): A select whose options are a tree, with a filter box, single or multiple selection with chips, and lazy children. The collections kit's TreeSelect. `import { TreeSelect } from "@kitora/collections/ui"`
- [Rating](/components/rating): Star rating on a radio group: arrow keys, half stars, clearable, read-only, custom icons, right-to-left. `import { Rating } from "@kitora/ui/rating"`
- [TransferList](/components/transfer-list): Pick a subset by moving items between two lists, with search, select-all and counts per side, keyboard multi-select and virtual rows for long lists. The collections kit's TransferList. `import { TransferList } from "@kitora/collections/ui"`
- [Mention](/components/mention): A plain textarea where @ or # opens ranked or loaded suggestions and picking one inserts its name as text. The collections kit's Mention. `import { Mention } from "@kitora/collections/ui"`
- [ModelSelector](/components/model-selector): A model picker for a chat composer or a settings form: models grouped by provider with an icon, a description and tags (context window, reasoning, vision), a search box above 8 models, a bottom sheet on a phone and a `name` that posts the chosen id. A preset of the ui Select; the ai-chat kit's ModelSelector. `import { ModelSelector } from "@kitora/ai-chat/ui"`
- [Checkbox](/components/checkbox): Boolean toggle for forms — pair with Label. `import { Checkbox } from "@kitora/ui/checkbox"`
- [Switch](/components/switch): Boolean toggle that suggests an immediate effect (vs Checkbox = stage). `import { Switch } from "@kitora/ui/switch"`
- [CheckboxGroup](/components/checkbox-group): Checkboxes that share one value, with a parent checkbox that ticks or clears them all (mixed while some are ticked). `import { CheckboxGroup } from "@kitora/ui/checkbox-group"`
- [RadioGroup](/components/radio-group): Mutually exclusive choice. Pair with Label per option. `import { RadioGroup } from "@kitora/ui/radio-group"`
- [ChoiceCard](/components/choice-card): Radio cards and checkbox cards: the whole card is the control, with an icon, a title, a price or other meta, a description and the radio or checkbox indicator; arrow keys in a radio group, a tab stop per checkbox card, form posting and Field wiring. `import { ChoiceCard } from "@kitora/ui/choice-card"`
- [Tabs](/components/tabs): Mutually exclusive panels — one tab visible at a time. `import { Tabs } from "@kitora/ui/tabs"`
- [BottomNav](/components/bottom-nav): The phone tab bar: 3 to 5 destinations as links along the bottom edge above the safe area, the current one marked by aria-current and more than a colour, count and dot badges with spoken labels, labels always or only on the current item, and hide on scroll. The shell kit's BottomNav parts and ShellBottomNav preset; AppShell draws it on phones from its bottomNav slot. `import { BottomNav } from "@kitora/shell"`
- [Breadcrumbs](/components/breadcrumb): Hierarchical nav trail that collapses the middle into a dropdown. The shell kit's Breadcrumbs parts and ShellBreadcrumbs preset. `import { Breadcrumbs } from "@kitora/shell"`
- [Menubar](/components/menubar): A bar of menus (File, Edit, View) with arrow-key movement between them and hover switching while one is open. `import { Menubar } from "@kitora/ui/menubar"`
- [NavigationMenu](/components/navigation-menu): A site or app navigation bar: links and triggers that disclose panels of links in one shared popup that morphs between them. Disclosure navigation, not a role=menu: Tab, arrows, Escape, hover with a delay, nested menus, vertical, RTL. `import { NavigationMenu } from "@kitora/ui/navigation-menu"`
- [Pagination](/components/pagination): Page jumps + prev/next. Keyboard-friendly, ellipsis for long ranges. `import { Pagination } from "@kitora/ui/pagination"`
- [Steps](/components/stepper): Multi-step flow indicator for wizards, onboarding and checkout: Stepper parts, the Steps preset and useStepper with linear or free navigation. The feedback kit's Stepper (tour re-exports it). `import { Steps } from "@kitora/feedback"`
- [Sidebar](/components/sidebar): App sidebar with sections, nested trees, badges, an icon rail and resizing, marking the active route from the location. The sidebar kit's Sidebar preset. `import { Sidebar } from "@kitora/sidebar"`
- [Link](/components/link): Inline text link with hover, always or no underline, safe external links with an announced new-tab hint, and render for router links or buttons. LinkBox and LinkOverlay make a whole card one link while its inner links and buttons keep working. `import { Link } from "@kitora/ui/link"`
- [TableOfContents](/components/table-of-contents): The "On this page" list: headings from the page or a list, nested by level, a scroll spy that marks the section being read, smooth scrolling and sticky placement. The shell kit's TableOfContents. `import { TableOfContents } from "@kitora/shell"`
- [Badge](/components/badge): Compact label. Status, category, or count. `import { Badge } from "@kitora/ui/badge"`
- [Avatar](/components/avatar): Image with deterministic initials fallback. `import { Avatar } from "@kitora/ui/avatar"`
- [Item](/components/item): A row of media, title, description and actions (notifications, settings, people, files) with outline and muted surfaces, three sizes, link or button rendering, a selected state on the list slot and actions that wrap in a narrow container. `import { Item } from "@kitora/ui/item"`
- [Highlight](/components/highlight): Search-hit marks over text: give it a query (case- and accent-insensitive), ranges from your own matcher, or a fuzzy matcher's indices. Exports the pure helpers queryRanges, indexRanges, mergeRanges and splitRanges. `import { Highlight } from "@kitora/ui/highlight"`
- [AvatarStack](/components/avatar-stack): Overlapping avatars with an overflow count, tooltips and presence. The display kit's AvatarStack. `import { AvatarStack } from "@kitora/display"`
- [Card](/components/card): Surface container — header, content, footer slots. `import { Card } from "@kitora/ui/card"`
- [StatCard](/components/stat-card): KPI tile with delta, hint and optional sparkline. The display kit's StatCard. `import { StatCard } from "@kitora/display"`
- [Skeleton](/components/skeleton): Pattern-shaped loading placeholder. Shape it to your real content. `import { Skeleton } from "@kitora/ui/skeleton"`
- [Meter](/components/meter): A scalar inside a known range (disk used, strength), role=meter, with Intl formatting for units and currencies. For progress toward a goal use Progress. `import { Meter } from "@kitora/ui/meter"`
- [Progress](/components/progress): Linear progress bar — uploads, steps, build state. `import { Progress } from "@kitora/ui/progress"`
- [Separator](/components/separator): Horizontal or vertical hairline divider. `import { Separator } from "@kitora/ui/separator"`
- [Accordion](/components/accordion): Collapsible sections — FAQs, settings groups, file trees. `import { Accordion } from "@kitora/ui/accordion"`
- [Collapsible](/components/collapsible): Single-section accordion. Show/hide a single block. `import { Collapsible } from "@kitora/ui/collapsible"`
- [AspectRatio](/components/aspect-ratio): Lock content to a specific ratio — video, image, embed. `import { AspectRatio } from "@kitora/ui/aspect-ratio"`
- [ScrollArea](/components/scroll-area): Scroll container with thin, styled scrollbars on both axes. @kitora/primitives underneath. `import { ScrollArea } from "@kitora/ui/scroll-area"`
- [ShellPage](/components/page-header): Page title, kicker, description, actions and tabs above the page body. The shell kit's ShellPage and Page parts. `import { ShellPage } from "@kitora/shell"`
- [PersonCard](/components/user-card): Avatar, name, presence and a second line (role, handle or email), static or clickable. The display kit's PersonCard. `import { PersonCard } from "@kitora/display"`
- [PricingTable](/components/pricing-card): Plan cards with interval toggle, prices, features and a call to action, plus an optional comparison table. The commerce kit's PricingTable and Pricing parts. `import { PricingTable } from "@kitora/commerce/ui"`
- [Hero](/components/hero): Centered hero composition — kicker chip, huge headline, dual CTA. Pairs with BackgroundGrid. `import { Hero } from "@kitora/ui/hero"`
- [QrCode](/components/qr-code): QR code drawn as one SVG path with selectable error correction, used for authenticator setup links. The auth kit's QrCode. `import { QrCode } from "@kitora/auth"`
- [FormatNumber](/components/format): Locale-aware numbers, currency, bytes, dates and relative times as components; a DisplayProvider sets the locale. The display kit's FormatNumber, FormatBytes, FormatDate and RelativeTime. `import { FormatNumber } from "@kitora/display"`
- [SplitView](/components/resizable): Resizable panes with pixel limits, collapsible panes, nesting and a keyboard-operable sash. The dock kit's SplitView, used without a dock. `import { SplitView } from "@kitora/dock"`
- [DescriptionList](/components/description-list): Term and value pairs inline, stacked or in a grid, with mono values, copy buttons and hints. The display kit's DescriptionList. `import { DescriptionList } from "@kitora/display"`
- [Carousel](/components/carousel): Scroll-snap slides with arrows, dots, several per page, loop and autoplay that pauses on hover, focus and reduced motion. The display kit's Carousel. `import { Carousel } from "@kitora/display"`
- [Masonry](/components/masonry): Items of mixed heights packed into columns with the DOM, Tab order and screen-reader order kept in source order: a column count, a responsive map or a minimum column width, a gap, packed or sequential placement, a server-rendered first paint, re-layout when an image loads late. The display kit's Masonry. `import { Masonry } from "@kitora/display"`
- [Tag](/components/tag): Coloured labels that can be removed or toggled; TagList folds the overflow into "+N". The display kit's Tag and TagList. `import { Tag } from "@kitora/display"`
- [Heading](/components/typography): Heading, Text, Blockquote and List: level picks the element and size the look, tones, truncate and line clamp, render for any element. `import { Heading } from "@kitora/ui/typography"`
- [OverflowList](/components/overflow-list): One row of tags, avatars, chips or breadcrumbs that keeps what fits and puts the rest behind a +N button opening a popover, by measuring on every resize: collapse from the end or the start, a maxVisible cap, a custom overflow control, and focus that never drops when an item leaves. `import { OverflowList } from "@kitora/ui/overflow-list"`
- [Prose](/components/prose): One look for rendered markdown, rich text and CMS HTML: headings, lists and task lists, quotes, links, inline code, pre, kbd, images, figures and tables on the table slot, in three sizes, mirrored in right-to-left text, with not-prose to keep a part out. The editors and ai-chat kits draw through it. `import { Prose } from "@kitora/ui/prose"`
- [Indicator](/components/indicator): A dot or count (99+) pinned to a logical corner of any child, with offset, a processing pulse and a screen-reader label. `import { Indicator } from "@kitora/ui/indicator"`
- [Image](/components/image): Image with a loading skeleton, a fallback source, a fallback node, fit and radius. `import { Image } from "@kitora/ui/image"`
- [Spoiler](/components/spoiler): Long content cut to a max height with a fade and a show more / show less button, controlled or uncontrolled. `import { Spoiler } from "@kitora/ui/spoiler"`
- [Shimmer](/components/shimmer): Text with a light band sweeping across it while work runs ("Thinking…", a running step); plain muted text under reduced motion. `import { Shimmer } from "@kitora/ui/shimmer"`
- [MessageScroller](/components/message-scroller): A focusable chat or log viewport that follows the newest content at the live edge, lets go when the reader scrolls up, keeps their place when older rows load, and shows Jump to latest while away. `import { MessageScroller } from "@kitora/ui/message-scroller"`
- [Message](/components/message): Store-free chat message parts: a sender group, start or end rows with avatar or time gutter, header, footer, status in words (Sending…, Not sent. Retry) and a hover action toolbar. `import { Message } from "@kitora/ui/message"`
- [Bubble](/components/bubble): The surface a message sits on: sizes to its content up to 85% of the row, its tail on the sender's side (mirrored in right to left), seven variants, and interactive content through render. `import { Bubble } from "@kitora/ui/bubble"`
- [Marker](/components/marker): A line in a conversation that is not a message: a named day separator (optionally sticky), a "New messages" row or a boxed status line. `import { Marker } from "@kitora/ui/marker"`
- [Attachment](/components/attachment): One file card for messages and composers: icon slot, name, size, upload progress and a named remove button, as a card or a chip. `import { Attachment } from "@kitora/ui/attachment"`
- [Trace](/components/trace): An agent's steps as an ordered list: status icon and text, a title that shimmers while it runs, duration, folded detail and nested steps, with plan, queue and subagent presets. The ai-chat kit's Trace. `import { Trace } from "@kitora/ai-chat/ui"`
- [ContextUsage](/components/context-usage): How much of a model's context window a conversation has used: a ring and percent for a composer toolbar, with the used and maximum tokens, a bar, a breakdown and the cost in a popover. Built on the feedback Meter; the ai-chat kit's ContextUsage. `import { ContextUsage } from "@kitora/ai-chat/ui"`
- [Tooltip](/components/tooltip): Hint that appears on hover/focus. Wrap with TooltipProvider in root. `import { Tooltip } from "@kitora/ui/tooltip"`
- [DropdownMenu](/components/dropdown-menu): Context menu / action menu with sub-menus, separators, destructive items. `import { DropdownMenu } from "@kitora/ui/dropdown-menu"`
- [ContextMenu](/components/context-menu): Right-click menu. Same items as dropdown, different trigger. `import { ContextMenu } from "@kitora/ui/context-menu"`
- [Popover](/components/popover): Floating surface for inline edits, settings, quick forms. `import { Popover } from "@kitora/ui/popover"`
- [HoverCard](/components/hover-card): Rich preview on hover — user profile, link previews, citation popovers. `import { HoverCard } from "@kitora/ui/hover-card"`
- [Dialog](/components/dialog): Declarative modal primitive (the primitives Dialog): focus-trapped, ESC closes, scroll lock. For modals that must stack, open from code or survive navigation, use Modal (managed) from the overlay kit. `import { Dialog } from "@kitora/ui/dialog"`
- [AlertDialog](/components/alert-dialog): Critical confirmation modal — destructive actions, data loss warnings. `import { AlertDialog } from "@kitora/ui/alert-dialog"`
- [Sheet](/components/sheet): Slide-in panel from any edge. Mobile menus, settings drawers. `import { Sheet } from "@kitora/ui/sheet"`
- [Drawer](/components/drawer): Bottom-sheet style drawer (the primitives Drawer: swipe to dismiss, snap points). Mobile-first. `import { Drawer } from "@kitora/ui/drawer"`
- [Command](/components/command): A filterable command list on the primitives' Autocomplete: groups of items with keyboard selection. The ⌘K dialog itself is CommandPalette from the overlay kit, which renders through this. `import { Command } from "@kitora/ui/command"`
- [Overlay](/components/modal): Modal (managed): the overlay kit's modal engine. Stacks modals, sheets and drawers, opens them from code with open(), guards dirty forms and survives route changes. Use Dialog for a single declarative modal, this when modals stack or open from code. `import { Overlay } from "@kitora/overlay"`
- [CommandPalette](/components/command-palette): ⌘K palette: fuzzy-search actions, navigate and run commands, inside the overlay stack. The overlay kit's CommandPalette, rendered through the ui Command primitive. `import { CommandPalette } from "@kitora/overlay"`
- [Affix](/components/affix): Content pinned to a viewport corner through a portal, clear of the safe-area insets, plus a BackToTop button that appears after scrolling. `import { Affix } from "@kitora/ui/affix"`
- [Popconfirm](/components/popconfirm): A small confirm anchored to the button that asked: focus on Cancel, Escape or a press outside cancels, async actions with a busy state and inline retry. The overlay kit's Popconfirm. `import { Popconfirm } from "@kitora/overlay"`
- [Alert](/components/alert): Inline alert / callout — info, warning, danger, success. `import { Alert } from "@kitora/ui/alert"`
- [Toast](/components/toast): Stacked notifications: typed, promise-based, hover and focus to expand and pause, F6 to reach them, swipe to dismiss, anchored to an element. The feedback kit's toaster (undo, positions, an inbox) builds on the same store. `import { Toast } from "@kitora/ui/toast"`
- [EmptyState](/components/empty-state): Icon, headline, one line of copy and the action that fills the space, in two sizes and an optional dashed frame; ResultPage is the whole-page 404 / 500 / success sibling. The feedback kit's EmptyState. `import { EmptyState } from "@kitora/feedback"`
- [StatusDot](/components/status-dot): Status dot in six tones and four sizes, with a visible label or an aria-label, and a pulse for live states that stops under reduced motion. The display kit's StatusDot. `import { StatusDot } from "@kitora/display"`
- [Kbd](/components/kbd): A key binding drawn as key caps with the platform's glyphs (⌘K on macOS, Ctrl K elsewhere), fixed or detected by the provider. The keyboard kit's Kbd. `import { Kbd } from "@kitora/keyboard"`
- [CodeBlock](/components/code-block): Code with a title bar, language chip, copy button, line numbers and highlighted lines; CodeTabs holds several files in one frame. The display kit's CodeBlock. `import { CodeBlock } from "@kitora/display"`
- [Banner](/components/banner): Full-width message strip in four tones, soft or solid, with actions and an optional dismiss. The feedback kit's Banner. `import { Banner } from "@kitora/feedback"`
- [NotificationBell](/components/notification-center): Bell with an unread count that opens the inbox list: tabs, unread filter, mark all read. The feedback kit's NotificationBell and Inbox parts. `import { NotificationBell } from "@kitora/feedback"`
- [TopProgress](/components/top-progress): A thin bar along the top of the page while a route change or a long save is under way: a store (start, set, increment, decrement, done, reset) that trickles and never finishes on its own, a loading boolean for router adapters with a delay against flashes, aria-busy on the page and a polite one-time announcement, and a fixed partial width under reduced motion. `import { TopProgress } from "@kitora/feedback"`
- [Spinner](/components/spinner): Loading ring in four sizes or three dots, announced as a status with its own label. The feedback kit's Spinner. `import { Spinner } from "@kitora/feedback"`
- [LoadingOverlay](/components/loading-overlay): Covers a region while it loads: dimmed or blurred, inert and aria-busy under a named spinner, its content kept mounted. The feedback kit's LoadingOverlay. `import { LoadingOverlay } from "@kitora/feedback"`
- [Table](/components/table): Bare-bones HTML table primitives — TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableCell. `import { Table } from "@kitora/ui/table"`
- [DataGrid](/components/data-table): Sortable, filterable, selectable grid with sticky header, pagination and per-row actions, on a data adapter (in-memory or server), with optional spreadsheet-style cell ranges (`cellSelection`), TSV copy and paste, undo of edits and grouped column headers (`columnGroups`). The datagrid kit's DataGrid; the full API lives on /kits/datagrid. `import { DataGrid } from "@kitora/datagrid"`
- [RadarChart](/components/radar-chart): Radar (spider) chart comparing several metrics across series on plain SVG: polygon or circle grid, rings, stripes, fill and dots, highlight by axis with a tooltip, legend toggles, arrow-key reading and a table view. The charts kit's RadarChart; every chart lives on /kits/charts. `import { RadarChart } from "@kitora/charts"`
- [RadialBarChart](/components/radial-bar-chart): Concentric bars against one full sweep (the largest value or a goal) on plain SVG: faint tracks, rounded ends, a 0° to 270° default sweep, input order or sorted, labels at the bar starts or a legend, arrow-key reading and a table view. The charts kit's RadialBarChart. `import { RadialBarChart } from "@kitora/charts"`
- [GaugeChart](/components/gauge-chart): One value on a dial between a minimum and a maximum: a 240° sweep by default, coloured bands with a legend, the formatted value in the centre and a WAI-ARIA meter root. Its arc is the same drawing as the feedback kit's Meter.Ring and CircularProgress. The charts kit's GaugeChart. `import { GaugeChart } from "@kitora/charts"`
- [FunnelChart](/components/funnel-chart): Conversion funnel on plain SVG: stages in their given order as joined trapezoids or centred bars, vertical or horizontal, labels with the value and the share of the first or previous stage, a tooltip with both, arrow-key reading and a table view. The charts kit's FunnelChart. `import { FunnelChart } from "@kitora/charts"`
- [BarsList](/components/bars-list): Ranked list of horizontal bars in HTML ("top pages"): names and values as real text over tinted bars sized by share of the largest, sorted, limited with a count of the rest, optional column headers, and rows as links or buttons. The charts kit's BarsList. `import { BarsList } from "@kitora/charts"`
- [FilterBar](/components/filter-bar): Chip-based filter row — add filter, clear all, saved views. `import { FilterBar } from "@kitora/ui/filter-bar"`
- [BulkActionBar](/components/bulk-action-bar): Sticky action bar that appears when rows are selected — count + bulk verbs. `import { BulkActionBar } from "@kitora/ui/bulk-action-bar"`
- [Timeline](/components/activity-feed): Timeline of events: actor, verb, object and relative time, with icons and connectors. The display kit's Timeline. `import { Timeline } from "@kitora/display"`
- [TreeView](/components/tree-view): Nested, collapsible tree with arrow-key navigation, ARIA tree roles, optional checkboxes and lazy-loaded children. The collections kit's TreeView. `import { TreeView } from "@kitora/collections/ui"`
- [FileTree](/components/file-tree): Folders and files on TreeView: built from a list of paths or your own nodes, folders first in natural order, the upload kit's icon per file kind, sizes and dates as the hint, Enter opens a file, and a folders-only picker; every TreeView feature (selection, checkboxes, lazy loading, filter, virtual rows) works unchanged. The collections kit's FileTree. `import { FileTree } from "@kitora/collections/ui"`
- [KanbanCard](/components/kanban-card): Compact card for board columns — title, badges, assignee, due. `import { KanbanCard } from "@kitora/ui/kanban-card"`
- [KanbanBoard](/components/kanban-board): Columns by status (or priority) with KanbanCards. Drag tasks across columns to change status. `import { KanbanBoard } from "@kitora/task-list"`
- [TaskList](/components/task-list): Compact list of tasks — checkbox, title, status, priority, owner, due. Optional grouping. `import { TaskList } from "@kitora/task-list"`
- [TaskListBoard](/components/task-list-board): Multiple TaskLists, drag-to-reorder, collapsible, add/delete. Things-style. `import { TaskListBoard } from "@kitora/task-list"`
- [JsonViewer](/components/json-viewer): Syntax-highlighted, collapsible JSON for API responses and configs, with parts and a preset. The display kit's JsonViewer. `import { JsonViewer } from "@kitora/display"`
- [LogViewer](/components/log-viewer): Streaming log lines with level filters, timestamps, search and follow-tail. The terminal kit's LogViewer. `import { LogViewer } from "@kitora/terminal/ui"`
- [APIKeyCard](/components/api-key-card): Reveal/copy/regenerate pattern for secret tokens. Mask by default. `import { APIKeyCard } from "@kitora/ui/api-key-card"`
- [VirtualList](/components/virtual-list): Renders only the visible rows of a huge list, fixed or measured heights, with scrollToIndex. The collections kit's VirtualList. `import { VirtualList } from "@kitora/collections/ui"`
- [ItemList](/components/item-list): A selectable list of Item rows that can hold buttons and links: single or multiple selection, checkboxes, row actions with Left and Right, Enter or double click to act, typeahead, and a virtual window for 10,000 rows. The collections kit's ItemList, the grid pattern of React Aria's GridList. `import { ItemList } from "@kitora/collections/ui"`
- [SortableList](/components/sortable-list): Reorder a list by pointer or keyboard, vertical or horizontal, with handles, pinned rows and announced moves. The dnd kit's SortableList. `import { SortableList } from "@kitora/dnd"`

## Source
